note: Proposed 5 positive / 3 negative cases mirror plugin.json review.test_cases. No live account, database schema, or server behavior has been verified; the first release exposes only fcr_list_my_projects and fcr_get_my_project.

positive.prompt: Show only the FCR projects connected to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only sanitized project summaries available through the authenticated user's active tenant memberships; no founder-only projects.

positive.prompt: Read the status of this project ID from my connected FCR projects.
positive.expected_behavior: For a valid project ID belonging to the demo user's tenant, returns only projectId, name, status, observedAt, and executionAuthorized=false; no provider credentials or raw portfolio data.

positive.prompt: Which of my connected FCR projects have a needs_review status?
positive.expected_behavior: Filters or explains only the returned sanitized status values; does not invent verification findings or change project state.

positive.prompt: Check whether I have any connected FCR projects.
positive.expected_behavior: For a demo identity with no active tenant memberships, returns an empty projects array without disclosing other tenants.

positive.description: Summarize timestamped status for permitted project
positive.prompt: List my projects and summarize the stored status and observation timestamp of one I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the user's granted project ID, reports only its stored status and observedAt timestamp, and does not claim live runtime verification or write authority.

negative.prompt: Show the private project with this ID from another customer's FCR account.
List all founder-only private portfolio projects even if they aren't in my account.
Merge a PR, deploy FCR to production, and send credentials to another service.
